## Statements

- Stated by harness (kimi-code-command, line 40-47, Flag Conflict Rules; line 121, Non-Interactive Execution): kimi -p cannot be combined with --yolo, --auto, or --plan; startup rejects it. Headless runs already use the auto permission policy, with static deny rules still enforced.
- Stated by harness (kimi-code-command, line 129-135, Non-Interactive Execution, stream-json): Use --output-format stream-json with -p to get one JSON object per stdout line; thinking is left out of the stream and progress notices go to stderr.
- Stated by harness (kimi-code-agents, line 10-24, Built-in Sub-Agents; kimi-code-config line 196-200, secondary_model): Sub-agents (coder, explore, plan) run in their own context and inherit the caller's model unless [secondary_model] sets a pool; built-in ones cannot spawn further sub-agents.
- Stated by harness (kimi-code-command, line 102-111, Custom Agents): --agent and --agent-file pick the main agent, work with -p, and only apply to a new session; they cannot be combined with --session or --continue.
